AS run_id),
source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT c.run_id,
 e.status AS current_status,
 e.operation_code,
 e.updated_at,
 e.started_at,
 e.lease_owner,e.lease_expires_at,e.lease_fence,e.checkpoint_seq,
 (e.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND e.lease_expires_at <= statement_timestamp()) AS lease_expired_now,
 (e.lease_expires_at>statement_timestamp()) AS lease_valid_now,
 (e.idempotency_key IS NOT NULL) AS has_idempotency_key,
 CASE WHEN e.idempotency_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE encode(sha256(convert_to(e.idempotency_key,'UTF8')),'hex') END AS idempotency_key_sha256,
 CASE WHEN e.idempotency_key IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (
   SELECT count(*) FROM public.lf_operation_execution d WHERE d.idempotency_key=e.idempotency_key
 ) END AS duplicate_idempotency_uses_across_all_runs,
 CASE WHEN e.execution_id IS NULL THEN NULL
 ELSE encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(e)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') END AS run_preimage_sha256,
 coalesce(s.n,0) AS step_count,
 coalesce(s.success_count,0) AS step_success,
 coalesce(s.github_write_count,0) AS github_write_positive,
 coalesce(s.write_count,0) AS step_write_indicators,
 coalesce(s.missing_step_evidence,0) AS success_without_evidence_ref,
 s.step_rows_sha256,
 coalesce(s.step_rows,'[]'::jsonb) AS step_rows,
 coalesce(g.n,0) AS guard_count,
 coalesce(g.succeeded,0) AS guard_succeeded,
 coalesce(g.reserved,0) AS guard_reserved,
 coalesce(g.abandoned,0) AS guard_abandoned,
 coalesce(g.success_without_receipt,0) AS guard_succeeded_missing_receipt,
 coalesce(g.duplicate_dispatch,0) AS guard_dispatch_duplicate_pairs,
 g.guard_rows_sha256,
 coalesce(g.guard_rows,'[]'::jsonb) AS guard_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.lf_operation_gate_check_results c2 WHERE c2.execution_id=c.run_id) AS gate_result_count,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.lf_rule_promotion_v1 rp WHERE rp.request_execution_id=c.run_id) AS promotion_rows
 FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN public.lf_operation_execution e ON e.execution_id=c.run_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE','STEP_CLEAN_PASS','WRITE_COMMITTED','PASS_CLEAN')) AS success_count,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE step_id='github_write' AND status IN ('STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE','STEP_CLEAN_PASS','WRITE_COMMITTED','PASS_CLEAN')) AS github_write_count,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE step_id ~* '(^|_)(capture_store|db_write|write_committed|publish|apply_migration|record_capture|persist|promotion_apply)($|_)' OR status='WRITE_COMMITTED') AS write_count,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('STEP_PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE','STEP_CLEAN_PASS','WRITE_COMMITTED','PASS_CLEAN') AND nullif(evidence_ref,'') IS NULL) AS missing_step_evidence,
   encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY step_order,step_id,created_at),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS step_rows_sha256,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('step_id',step_id,'step_order',step_order,'status',status,
       'evidence_ref',evidence_ref,
       'evidence_payload_sha256',CASE WHEN evidence_payload IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE encode(sha256(convert_to(evidence_payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex') END,
       'created_at',created_at,'observed_at',observed_at) ORDER BY step_order,step_id,created_at),'[]'::jsonb) AS step_rows
  FROM public.lf_operation_execution_steps s WHERE s.execution_id=c.run_id
 ) s ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS n,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='RESERVED') AS reserved,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='ABANDONED') AS abandoned,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='SUCCEEDED' AND (receipt IS NULL OR receipt='{}'::jsonb OR receipt='null'::jsonb)) AS success_without_receipt,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE dispatch_key IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.lf_operation_effect_guard g2 WHERE g2.dispatch_key=gu.dispatch_key AND g2.effect_scope=gu.effect_scope)>1) AS duplicate_dispatch,
   encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(gu) ORDER BY effect_scope,dispatch_key,created_at),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS guard_rows_sha256,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('effect_scope',effect_scope,'state',state,
       'dispatch_key_sha256',CASE WHEN dispatch_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE encode(sha256(convert_to(dispatch_key,'UTF8')),'hex') END,
       'effect_request_sha256',effect_request_sha256,
       'receipt_present',CASE WHEN receipt IS NULL OR receipt='{}'::jsonb OR receipt='null'::jsonb THEN false ELSE true END,
       'receipt_sha256',CASE WHEN receipt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE encode(sha256(convert_to(receipt::text,'UTF8')),'hex') END,
       'reserved_at',reserved_at,'resolved_at',resolved_at) ORDER BY effect_scope,dispatch_key,created_at),'[]'::jsonb) AS guard_rows
  FROM public.lf_operation_effect_guard gu WHERE gu.execution_id=c.run_id
 ) g ON true
), packed AS (
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(source_rows) ORDER BY to_jsonb(source_rows)::text),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM source_rows
)
SELECT statement_timestamp() AS as_of, jsonb_array_length(rows) AS n,
encode(sha256(convert_to(rows::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS result_sha256,rows::text AS canonical_jsonb_text FROM packed;
